description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 01.11.2021 to 07.11.2021
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, falls under statutory instruments/subsidiary legislation, and rescinds a previous notification - all characteristics of Legal/Regulatory matters. While it names the Director General of Customs, this is in an official capacity to establish legal authority rather than being a personnel appointment or describing government structure.
